sections.label: A team approach, built around the child
text: A team approach, built around the child
We work directly with the three people who matter most in a child's daily life — no referral wrangling, no waiting lists that stretch into years.
Children & Young People
From toddlers to teens, we support development in fine and gross motor skills, sensory processing, self-regulation and daily living tasks like dressing, handwriting and mealtimes.
Families
Parents and carers are part of every step. We offer practical home strategies, coaching sessions and honest guidance — so support doesn't stop when the appointment ends.
Schools
We liaise with SENCOs and teaching staff, provide classroom observations, staff training and written recommendations that fit real school days, not just clinic rooms.
Who We Support

sections.label: Assessment and therapy, tailored to each child
text: Assessment and therapy, tailored to each child
Every child is different, so every plan is built from scratch — informed by standardised assessment, observation, and conversations with the people who know them best.
OT Assessments
Comprehensive assessments covering sensory processing, motor skills, self-care and school function, with a clear written report and practical recommendations.
1:1 Therapy Sessions
Ongoing, play-based therapy delivered in our clinic, at home or in school, targeting the goals identified in your child's assessment.
Sensory Integration Therapy
Specialist support for children who find certain sounds, textures, movement or environments overwhelming, using an evidence-based sensory integration approach.
Handwriting & Fine Motor Groups
Small-group and individual programmes to build pencil grip, letter formation and hand strength, tailored to age and school curriculum stage.
School Consultancy & Training
Classroom observations, sensory circuit design, staff CPD sessions and written strategies to help schools support children with additional needs.
EHCP & Tribunal Reports
Independent OT reports for Education, Health and Care Plan applications, annual reviews, and tribunal proceedings, written in plain, evidence-led language.

sections.label: Getting started is simple
text: Getting started is simple
No GP referral needed. Most families are seen within two to three weeks of their first enquiry.
Free Phone Consultation
Tell us what's going on. We'll listen and let you know honestly whether OT is the right fit.
Assessment
A thorough, unhurried assessment in the setting that makes most sense — clinic, home or school.
Written Report & Plan
You'll receive a clear report with findings, goals and a realistic, family-friendly action plan.
Ongoing Support
Therapy blocks, school liaison or review appointments — whatever keeps momentum going.
How It Works

text: Founded by an occupational therapist who wanted something better for families

Sensphere was founded by Chartered Occupational Therapist Priya Anand, after years working in NHS paediatric services and watching families wait far too long for far too little contact time. sections.label: Frequently asked questions
text: Frequently asked questions
Do we need a referral from our GP or paediatrician?

No. Sensphere accepts self-referrals directly from parents and carers, as well as referrals from schools, GPs and other professionals. You can get in touch and book a free consultation without any paperwork first.
Where do sessions take place?
We offer appointments at our clinic in Leeds, in your child's school (with school agreement), or in your own home. Many families use a mix, depending on the goals we're working on.
Can Sensphere write a report for an EHCP or tribunal?
Yes. We regularly write independent OT reports for EHC needs assessments, annual reviews and SEND tribunal proceedings, based on formal assessment and observation.
What age range do you work with?
We support children and young people from age 2 up to 18, including transition-age young people preparing for college or further education.
How much does an assessment cost?
Costs depend on the type and setting of assessment. We'll give you a clear, written quote after your free phone consultation, with no obligation to proceed.
Do you offer support for schools directly?
Yes. Schools can commission Sensphere for pupil-specific consultations, staff training days, or whole-setting sensory audits. Get in touch and we'll put together a proposal.
